metadata.match_title: Malaysia Women vs Sri Lanka Women
metadata.toss: Sri Lanka Women won the toss and opted to bowl
metadata.status_note: Sri Lanka Women won by 86 runs

ball_by_ball.commentary_text: DROPPED! Length delivery outside-off, Kavisha runs down the track and heaves it to deep mid-wicket where Winifred Duraisingam runs to her left and spills the catch. Two runs taken as Sri Lanka finish with 160/4 off their 20 overs! Kavisha Dilhari's 44* (27) played a huge part in taking Sri Lanka to this total!
Length delivery bowled wide of off, Kavisha tries to cut it behind point but she doesn't connect. No run.
Short-ish on the stumps, Hansima pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

WICKET! FINALLY SOME RESPITE FOR MALAYSIA! Short on the stumps, Harshitha wants to get low and pull it over square-leg but she miscues it. Simple catch for the fielder at backward square-leg who moves to her right and completes the take to send Harshitha back to the hut!

WICKET! FINALLY SOME RESPITE FOR MALAYSIA! Short on the stumps, Harshitha wants to get low and pull it over square-leg but she miscues it. Simple catch for the fielder at backward square-leg who moves to her right and completes the take to send Harshitha back to the hut!
FOUR! Short and wide of off, Harshitha gets closer to the ball and cuts it between short third and backward point for a boundary.
Full and wide of off from around the wicket, Harshitha drives it past the diving fielder at extra-cover for a couple of runs.
Full outside-off, Harshitha backs away and drives it to mid-off for a single.
Yorker outside-leg, Kavisha backs away and jams it to cover for a single.
HAT-TRICK OF FOURS! KAVISHA DILHARI PLAYING A CRACKING KNOCK! Full-toss on off from around the wicket, Kavisha sweeps it behind square for a boundary.
FOUR MORE! Full on off, Kavisha gets down on her knee and sweeps it to the right of long-on for another boundary.

FOUR! Full and wide of off, Kavisha walks across to her right and sweeps the ball through square-leg for a boundary. Excellent effort from the fielder at deep mid-wicket racing to her right and then diving but she couldn't stop the ball.
Full outside-off from around the wicket, Harshitha comes down the track and drives it to short extra-cover where the fielder fumbles. Single taken.
Short and wide of off, Kavisha cracks it to cover-point. No run.
FOUR! Full-toss outside-off, Kavisha swings it through deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Juicy full-toss and she was probably lucky to get away with a no-ball call as well.

Full and wide of off, Kavisha walks across a long way to her right and attempts the sweep shot while she gets a top-edge to fly over backward square-leg. Good work in the deep while the batters get two runs.
FOUR! Length delivery bowled wide of off. Kavisha walks across and sweeps it behind square for a boundary. Nice foot-work to create the shot.
Short and wide of off, Harshitha cracks it to deep cover for a single.
Full outside-off from over the wicket, Kavisha goes for the sweep shot while she gets a top-edge with the ball landing well in front of long-on. Single taken.
Length delivery bowled wide of off, Kavisha walks down the track and wants to go big but only mis-times it to long-on. Single taken.
Length delivery bowled wide of off, Kavisha cracks it to short extra-cover. No run.
Full and wide of off, Kavisha drives it superbly to the right of deep cover for a couple of runs. Good work in the deep to dive and stop the ball.
POOR BALL AND PUT AWAY! Full-toss bowled down the leg-side, Kavisha helps it through fine-leg for a boundary.
Full outside-leg, Harshitha walks across and tries to sweep it through fine-leg but she misses it. Leg-bye completed.
Yorker bowled wide of off from over the wicket, Harshitha jams the bat down in order to guide the ball through third but she doesn't connect. No run.
Length delivery bowled wide of off, Harshitha cuts it to cover-point for a single.
Full and wide of off, Harshitha gets down on her knee and tries to sweep but she doesn't connect.
Short-ish and wide of off, Harshitha cuts it to point where the fielder almost over-runs and gets done in by the spin to concede a couple of runs.
Full and wide of off, Harshitha comes forward and chips it in front of long-off. Two runs taken.
Short and wide of off, Kavisha cuts it to cover-point and races across for a single.
Full outside-off from over the wicket, Kavisha walks down the track and goes inside-out over extra-cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Full on middle, Harshitha swings it towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder is a bit late to pick the ball up. It falls short of her and races to the fence as well.
Full and angling in, Kavisha walks down the track and drives it straight but the bowler lets it go through for a single.
Full on off, Harshitha drives it to long-off for a single.
Yorker length outside-off, Kavisha drives it to deep cover for a single.
Yorker outside-off, Kavisha wants to squeeze it through third but doesn't connect.
Full-toss outside-off from over the wicket, Harshitha drives it to deep cover for a single.
Length delivery outside-off, Kavisha cuts it to cover-point. No run.
Short-ish outside-off, Harshitha heaves it to backward square-leg where the fielder fumbles. Single taken and that brings up Sri Lanka's 100.
Full on middle, Harshitha pushes it down the pitch. No run.
FOUR! Short delivery with width, Harshitha gladly cuts it through point for a boundary. Not the best delivery to a newcomer.

WICKET! Length delivery on the stumps, Chamari dances down the track and tries to go big but she doesn't get the best connection. The fielder at long-off stays calm and completes an important catch! End of a fine knock from the Sri Lankan skipper!

WICKET! Length delivery on the stumps, Chamari dances down the track and tries to go big but she doesn't get the best connection. The fielder at long-off stays calm and completes an important catch! End of a fine knock from the Sri Lankan skipper!
Length delivery from over the wicket, Kavisha chips it just wide of short extra-cover for a single.
Length delivery outside-off, Kavisha cuts it to point where the fielder slides to her right but fumbles. Single taken.
Length delivery outside-off, Kavisha guides it to backward point. No run.
Short and wide of off, Chamari swipes it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside-off, Chamari drives it to cover where the fielder makes a good stop. No run.
Full and wide of off, Kavisha lunges forward and drives it to long-off for a single.
Length delivery angling in from around the wicket, Chamari drives it to long-on for a single.
Full outside-off and turning in, Kavisha guides it fine of short third for a couple of runs.
Full on middle, Chamari comes forward and pushes it to long-on for a single.
Length delivery outside-off, Kavisha guides it fine of short third for a single.
WICKET! Tossed up full and wide of off, Hasini tries to lift it over covers but she gets a thick outside-edge to point where the fielder runs to her right and completes a fine catch!
WICKET! Tossed up full and wide of off, Hasini tries to lift it over covers but she gets a thick outside-edge to point where the fielder runs to her right and completes a fine catch!
Full-toss on the pads, Chamari heaves it to deep backward square-leg for a single.
Big full-toss outside-off from around the wicket, Hasini heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside-off, Chamari steers it to backward point. No run.

IN THE AIR BUT DROPPED! Full on the stumps, Hasini aims to flick it through mid-wicket but she only skies it to long-on where Mahirah runs in and gets to the ball but proceeds to spill it. Single taken.
Length delivery angling in, Chamari pushes it to long-on for a single.
FOUR! Full and angling in, Chamari swings it in front of square for a boundary. Winifred under pressure!
SIX! Full and wide of off, Chamari lifts it crisply over long-off for a maximum. This big hit brings up her fifty off 28 balls. What a player she is!
Full outside-off from around the wicket, Chamari drives it to short extra-cover. No run.
Low full-toss on the stumps, Chamari comes forward and drives it to long-off for a single.
Length delivery on off, Hasini pushes it to long-on for a single.
FOUR! Full and wide of off, Hasini walks across, gets down on her knee and sweeps it behind square for a boundary. Totally in control!
Full and wide of off, Chamari comes down the track and drives it to deep cover for a single.
Full on off, Chamari drives it to short mid-wicket. No run.
FOUR! Length delivery outside-off from around the wicket, Chamari goes for the cut shot while she gets an outside-edge to race through third for a boundary.
Short outside-off, Chamari pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short-ish outside-off, Chamari looks to cut but she doesn't connect.
FOUR! Way too short and way too down leg, Chamari happily heaves it behind square for a boundary.
SIX! Short on the stumps, Chamari rocks back and pulls it handsomely over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Can't bowl short at this pace.
Length delivery bowled wide of off, Hasini stretches and slashes it with one hand to deep cover. Single taken.
Short and wide of off from around the wicket, Chamari slashes it to deep cover for a single.
Full outside-off, Chamari drives it to long-off for a single.
Full on middle, Chamari gets forward to flick it square but she doesn't connect. Half an appeal for LBW turned down.
Full on middle, Hasini walks across and sweeps it through 45 for a single.
Very full outside-off, Hasini squeezes it to short extra-cover. No run.
Length delivery bowled wide of off, Hasini walks across and drags it to square-leg. Mix-up between the batters but everything is fine in the end.
Full on middle from around the wicket. Hasini drives it to short mid-wicket. No run.
Length delivery bowled wide of off, Hasini cracks it to cover-point for a single.
Full outside-leg, Chamari drives it to long-on for a single.
FOUR! Short outside-leg, Chamari pulls it easily over backward square-leg for a boundary. She had so much time to pick her spot.
Full and wide of off, Chamari walks down the track and cracks it through point for a couple of runs.
Full on off, Chamari defends it to cover-point. No run.
Full and wide of off from over the wicket, Chamari walks down the track to drive it square but she doesn't connect.
Length delivery outside-off, Hasini pushes it to cover-point. No run.
Full outside-off, Hasini cuts it to point. No run.

FOUR! Full outside-off, Hasini slashes hard while she gets an outside-edge to short third. The fielder positioned there slides but the ball deflects off the knee and rolls to the fence for a boundary. The bowler doesn't look impressed!
Length delivery outside-off, Hasini cuts it to point. No run.
Tossed up full and wide of off, Hasini lets it go to the keeper. No run.
FOUR! Length delivery outside-off from around the wicket, Hasini walks across and sweeps it in front of square for a boundary.

FOUR MORE TO END THE OVER! Length delivery on the stumps, Chamari walks down the track and drives it to the right of long-off where the fielder dives but fails to stop the ball from reaching the fence.
SIX! OMINOUS SIGNS FOR MALAYSIA! Length delivery on the stumps, Chamari walks down the track and swings it cleanly over wide long-on for a maximum. This should give her loads of confidence!
Full and angling outside the tramline, left alone. WIDE called.
BACK-TO-BACK FOURS! Full and wide of off, Chamari gets low to glide it behind point but she ends up with an outside-edge which races through third for a boundary.
FOUR! Length delivery on the stumps, Chamari swipes it off the inside-half of the bat through mid-wicket for a boundary. Not the most technically correct shot but she will take it either way.
Full on the stumps, Hasini heaves it through mid-on for a single.
Length delivery on off and angling away from over the wicket, Hasini cracks it behind point. No run.
Very full outside-off, Hasini steers it to backward point where the fielder dives to her right and makes a half-stop. Single taken.
Length delivery on middle and sliding in, Hasini tries to clip it behind square but doesn't connect. Stifled LBW appeal turned down.
Length delivery on off, Hasini defends it down the pitch. No run.
Full and wide of off, Hasini cracks it to point. No run.
Full outside-off, Hasini cuts it to point. No run.
Short-ish on the stumps from around the wicket, Hasini backs away and cuts it fine of short third. Great effort from the fielder to run back and dive to push the ball inside. Two runs taken.
BEATEN! Full on off and seaming away, Chamari pokes and misses it.
Length delivery outside-leg, Hasini clips it to mid-wicket for a single.

EARLY WICKET FOR MALAYSIA! Length delivery angling in, Dulani clips it to short mid-wicket and races forward for a single but Chamari Athapaththu turns her back. The fielder comes in and fires a high throw to the keeper who does well to collect the ball and dislodge the bails. Dulani will be disappointed to get out like this.

EARLY WICKET FOR MALAYSIA! Length delivery angling in, Dulani clips it to short mid-wicket and races forward for a single but Chamari Athapaththu turns her back. The fielder comes in and fires a high throw to the keeper who does well to collect the ball and dislodge the bails. Dulani will be disappointed to get out like this.
Full outside-off, Dulani pushes it back to the bowler. No run.
Short of a length outside-off, Dulani cracks it to point. No run.
Full delivery outside-off from over the wicket, Dulani looks to swing towards mid-wicket but misses it.
Length delivery outside-off, Chamari cracks it to cover. No run.

Full outside-off, Dhanusri pushes it to point and takes off for a single. A direct-hit at the bowler's end would have got Dhanusri comfortably but the fielder couldn't do it. Either way, Sri Lanka complete a dominant 86-run victory to advance to the Semi-finals of this Women's Asian Games Cricket Competition!
FOUR! Full outside-off, Dhanusri opens the bat face and steers it to the right of backward point for a boundary. Nice shot from Dhanusri!
Length delivery angling in, Nur Arianna clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
THE WICKETS KEEP TUMBLING! Full and angling in, Nur Dania tries to drive it straight but the ball takes the inside-edge and crash onto the leg-stump. Nur Dania has to depart for a two-ball duck!
THE WICKETS KEEP TUMBLING! Full and angling in, Nur Dania tries to drive it straight but the ball takes the inside-edge and crash onto the leg-stump. Nur Dania has to depart for a two-ball duck!
Length delivery on the stumps, Nur Dania pushes it back to the bowler. No run.
Full and down the leg-side, WIDE called.
WICKET! Length delivery on the stumps from over the wicket, Mahirah pushes it back to the bowler, Mithali Ayodhya who takes a sharp return catch. Needed to be alert and Mithali was!
WICKET! Length delivery on the stumps from over the wicket, Mahirah pushes it back to the bowler, Mithali Ayodhya who takes a sharp return catch. Needed to be alert and Mithali was!
Full and quick on the stumps, Dhanusri comes forward and defends it down the pitch. No run.

WICKET! Length delivery outside-off and turning in, Nurin looks to tuck it square but she misses the ball completely as it goes onto rattle the middle and leg sticks. Chamari has a big grin on her face!

WICKET! Length delivery outside-off and turning in, Nurin looks to tuck it square but she misses the ball completely as it goes onto rattle the middle and leg sticks. Chamari has a big grin on her face!
Length delivery on off, Nurin attempts to hoick it through square-leg but she only gets an inside-edge onto the pad. No run.
Length delivery outside-off, Nurin stays back to guide it through point but the ball goes past the outside-edge.

WICKET! Full outside-off, Winifred wants to crack it through point but she only gets an outside-edge which is taken superbly by the keeper, Kaushini Nuthyangana. Chamari starring with bat and ball like she usually does.

WICKET! Full outside-off, Winifred wants to crack it through point but she only gets an outside-edge which is taken superbly by the keeper, Kaushini Nuthyangana. Chamari starring with bat and ball like she usually does.
Tossed up full, Mahirah drags it to long-on for a single.
Full on middle and turning down leg from over the wicket, Mahirah gets down on her knee to sweep the ball through fine-leg but she doesn't connect. WIDE called.

Length delivery outside-off, Winifred cuts it between short third and backward point. The fielder at backward point races back and dives to flick the ball inside. Two runs saved. It was Sugandika Kumari with the effort.
Yorker angling in, Winifred aims to flick it square but she doesn't connect. No run.
Full on the stumps, Mahirah heaves it to long-on for a single.
Short of a length outside-off, Mahirah cuts it to backward point. No run.
Full on the stumps, Winifred pushes it to cover and completes a quick single.
Short of a length and angling in from over the wicket, Mahirah mis-times the pull shot well in front of deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Touch short and turning down leg, Mahirah pulls it to deep backward square-leg for a single.
Full outside-off, Mahirah comes forward and pushes it to cover. No run.
Length delivery bowled wide of off from over the wicket, Mahirah looks to cut it through third but she misses it.
Full outside-off from around the wicket, Mahirah makes some room and drives it to short extra-cover. No run.
Full outside-off, Mahirah lifts it in front of mid-off. No run.
Tossed up full outside-off and turning in from over the wicket, Mahirah gets forward to push the ball through cover but she misses it.
Full outside-off, Mahirah heaves it to long-on for a single.
Full on the leg-stump and turning in, Winifred clips it to deep backward square-leg for a single.
Full on middle and turning in, Winifred wants to tuck it square but she doesn't connect.
Length delivery turning in sharply, Winifred thinks about clipping it through mid-wicket but only gets an inside-edge onto the pad. No run.
Full on off, Winifred drives it back to the bowler. No run.
Yorker outside-leg from over the wicket, Mahirah walks forward and squeezes it to long-on for a single.
Full outside-off, Mahirah comes down the track and drives it hard while the ball goes through the hands of Sugandika to long-off. Single taken.
Full on off, Mahirah comes down the track and drives it to mid-off. No run.
Full outside-off, Mahirah drives it back to the bowler. No run.
Full and sliding in, Mahirah wants to clip it through square-leg but she doesn't connect. No run.
Full outside-off, Winifred steers it to backward point for a quick single.
Full outside-off from around the wicket, Winifred treks back to push the ball through point but she doesn't get bat on ball. So close to the off-stump!
Yorker on off, Mahirah squeezes it out to the leg-side. No run.
Full on the stumps, Winifred pushes it to long-on for a single.
Low full-toss on the leg-stump, Mahirah heaves it to deep backward square-leg for a single.
Short-ish outside-off, Winifred tucks it to long-on for a single.
Full on the stumps, Mahirah heaves it to long-on for a single.
Low full-toss outside-off from over the wicket, Mahirah pushes it back to the bowler. No run.
Full on the stumps, Mahirah heaves it to long-on for a single. 50 up for Malaysia!
Full outside-off, Mahirah goes for the sweep and ends up with a top-edge towards mid-wicket with the ball landing safely. The batters go for the second run and Mahirah has to dive back to the crease.
Short and wide of off, Mahirah cuts it to cover-point. No run.
Full outside-off, Winifred drives it to mid-off. Single taken.
Full outside-off, Winifred comes forward and pushes it to short extra-cover. No run.
Yorker on the stumps, Mahirah pushes it to mid-on. Single taken.
Length delivery angling in, Winifred tries to work it through mid-wicket but she only gets an inside-edge onto the pad. No run.
Yorker on off, Mahirah squeezes it to long-on for a single.
Full on the stumps, Winifred pushes it to long-on for a single.
Full on off, Winifred comes forward to push it through mid-on but she only gets an inside-edge onto the pad. No run.
Full outside-off, Winifred drives it through cover for a couple of runs. Winifred wanted a third but Mahirah Izzati Ismail rightly sent her back.
Length delivery outside-off from over the wicket, Winifred wants to cut it through third but she doesn't connect.
Length delivery outside-off, Mahirah pushes it to point. No run.
Full on off, Mahirah comes forward to clip it through mid-on but she only gets a leading-edge which falls in front of the bowler. No run.
Full outside-off, Winifred drives it to mid-off for a single.
Tossed up full outside-off, Winifred looks to drive it through covers but she misses it.
Full on middle, Mahirah turns it to square-leg for a single.
Full and down the leg-side, Mahirah misses the sweep shot. WIDE called.
Length delivery outside-off and drifting in from around the wicket. Mahirah chops it to point. No run.
Tossed full, around off. Duraisingam drives it back at the bowler.
Good length delivery on the stumps. Ismail clips it to square leg for a single.
Short of a length outside off. Cuts it behind point for one.
Drops the ball short on the stumps. Ismail drags it to deep square leg for one.
On a length outside off. Duraisingam cuts it behind point for one.
Over the wicket. Drops the ball short outside the off-stump. Ismail mistimes the pull towards mid-wicket for one.
On a length at the pads. Duraisingam looks to work across the line but misses onto the pads.
Fuller and on the middle and leg. Ismail gets forward and flicks it to square leg for one.
Tossed full, on the stumps. Defends it in the leg side.
Length delivery down the leg. Ismail looks to help it on its way but misses. The keeper whips off the bails but the batter managed to plant her bat inside the crease on time.
Length delivery around off. Ismail hangs back and taps it to point.
FOUR RUNS! Streaky boundary for Ismail! Around the wicket. Fuller and around off. Ismail drives and gets the thick outside edge, going through the small gap between keeper and first slip for a four.
Fuller and around off. Duraisingam gets forward and drives it to mid-off. Maiden over!
Fuller and around off. Duraisingam lunges forward and jams it to bowler.
On a length at the stumps. Hangs back and punches it to cover.
Fuller and outside off. Duraisingam presses forward and drives it to cover.
Fuller and on the stumps. Pushes it back at the bowler.
Hat-trick ball! Over the wicket. Good length delivery spinning into the stumps. Duraisingam defends it back at the bowler.
Fuller and angled on the middle and leg. Flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed full, angled on the stumps. Gets forward and clips it in the leg side for one.
Fuller and on the off-stump. Ismail pushes it to point.
On a length around off. Hangs back and dabs it to point.
Too full and on the stumps. Charges down and jams it to mid-on.
Around the wicket. Short of a length outside off. Drags it to long-on for one.

An appeal for LBW, and the finger is raised. Back-to-back wickets for Kavisha, and she will be on a hat-trick in her next over. Flighted delivery spinning into the batter. Elysa leans forward and looks to play across the line but gets pinged on the pads. Malaysia Women in deep trouble now.

An appeal for LBW, and the finger is raised. Back-to-back wickets for Kavisha, and she will be on a hat-trick in her next over. Flighted delivery spinning into the batter. Elysa leans forward and looks to play across the line but gets pinged on the pads. Malaysia Women in deep trouble now.

GONE! Kavisha Dilhari strikes in her first over, and Julia has to walk back for just 9 runs. Good length delivery, pitches around off-stump and spins in sharply. The batter backs away and looks to play off the backfoot but is completely outplayed by the sharp turn, as the ball beats the inside edge of the bat and hits the top of leg stump.

GONE! Kavisha Dilhari strikes in her first over, and Julia has to walk back for just 9 runs. Good length delivery, pitches around off-stump and spins in sharply. The batter backs away and looks to play off the backfoot but is completely outplayed by the sharp turn, as the ball beats the inside edge of the bat and hits the top of leg stump.
On a length around off. Julia hangs back and dabs it to point.
On a length, spinning down the leg. Julia misses the glance. A mild appeal for caught behind but umpire gives it wide.
Flighted delivery on the pads. Julia defends it in the leg side.
Tossed full, on the stumps. Defends it to mid-on.
Over the wicket. Flighted delivery around off. Drives it to cover.
Fuller and around off-stump line. Duraisingam jams it to left of bowler.
Back of a length around off. Duraisingam hangs back and defends it awkwardly towards bowler.
Length delivery around off. Duraisingam punches it to cover.
Back of a length outside off. Duraisingam plays off the backfoot and gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR RUNS! Cut away nicely! Back of a length outside the off-stump. Duraisingam stays back and cuts it towards deep backward point for a boundary.
Over the wicket. On a length around off. Defends in the off-side.
Good length delivery on the stumps. Defends it back at the bowler.
FOUR RUNS! Wristy work! Fuller and on the stumps. Julia uses her wrists and flicks it to deep square leg for a four.
Fuller and sliding down the leg. Julia misses the flick. Wide called.
Good length delivery on the stumps. Julia defends off the crease.
Back of a length around off. Cuts it straight to cover-point fielder.
Fuller and just outside off. Julia drives it to cover-point.
Over the wicket. Length delivery outside off. Julia cuts at it but misses.
Fuller and on the stumps. Duraisingam drives it to mid-on.
FOUR RUNS! Nicely driven! Fuller and just outside the off-stump. Duraisingam leans into it and drives it through cover-point for a four.
Length delivery outside off. Duraisingam drives it in front of square for a double.
Back of a length outside off. Duraisingam flashes at it but misses.
On a length around off. Punches it to cover.
Good length delivery on the stumps. Duraisingam defends it back at the bowler.
Over the wicket. Back of a length outside off. Duraisingam leaves it alone. Wide called.
Too full and on the pads. Julia jams it to short mid-wicket.
Yorker tailing on the pads. Julia misses the flick onto the pads.
Fuller and around off. Julia drives it to short cover.
Good length outside off. Duraisingam dabs it towards gully for one.
Length delivery on the stumps. Tucks across to square leg for one.
Over the wicket. Length delivery on the stumps. Hangs back and works it in the off-side for one.
FOUR RUNS! Length delivery outside the off-stump. Julia hangs back and dabs it to deep third man for a four.
On a length at the stumps. Wan Julia looks to work across the line but gets hit high on the pads.

A big mix-up, and Ainna Hamizah Hashim is run out at the bowling end. Fuller and outside the off-stump. Wan Julia square drives it to point and takes a few steps forward, looking for a single, but backs out as the fielder inside the ring makes a solid diving stop. However, Ainna Hamizah continues to run and almost reaches the other end. She tried to make a U-turn, but failed to get inside the crease on time.

However, Ainna Hamizah continues to run and almost reaches the other end. She tried to make a U-turn, but failed to get inside the crease on time.
Tossed full and on the stumps. Duraisingam mistimes the sweep to fine leg for a single. Oh, the umpire signals it leg bye.
Fuller and on the off stump line. Drives it to short cover.
Around the wicket. Fuller and around off. Drives it to mid-off.
